title: Session Root-Cause Canvas for Transient Retry Patterns
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Design and prototype a Session Root-Cause Canvas: a session-scoped debugging surface that synthesizes failed requests, retry chains, transient error clusters, and key environmental signals (region/zone, model-variant, kernel choice, batch size, KV cache hit rate) into a single interactive canvas. The canvas should help engineers and SREs quickly identify if an error pattern is session-local (e.g., mis-configured client retries, truncated KV cache), infrastructure-correlated (zone flapping, GPU OOMs), or model-related (decoding errors, tokenization mismatches). Include an embeddable payload inspector slideout for sampled requests with redaction controls and a cost overlay that surfaces per-session token spend during the failure window.
acceptance_criteria: Canvas surfaces a timeline of session activity with failed request markers and retry chains aggregated into collapsible groups
Heatmap view highlights transient spikes by region and model variant across the selected time window
Payload inspector opens as a side-sheet from any failed request marker and shows sampled request/response with redaction toggles and a link-to-PR (if a correlated PR exists)
Default time window set to 48h with quick presets (1h, 6h, 24h, 48h, 7d) and an auto-zoom that centers on highest-error density period
Canvas supports filtering by session id, user id, model, region, and status code and updates cost overlay in real time
Prototype passes PM/Eng design review and usability test with two SREs and two product engineers (tasks recorded in comments)
decisions: Keep payload sampling default to 10 requests per session; add explicit 'capture all' toggle for on-demand investigations
Payload inspector will be a side-sheet to avoid losing timeline context; deep-dive links open to a new tab for full-size inspection
Cost overlay will show aggregated token and GPU time estimates using existing cost model from Optimize
Default session retention window for canvas data is 30 days; extended retention gated behind paid retention add-on
tradeoffs: Full payload retention improves root-cause fidelity but increases storage and compliance surface — mitigated by sampling + redaction controls
Aggressive aggregation reduces noise but can hide edge-case causal chains; we provide an expand-to-raw view for suspicious clusters
Including kernel-level metrics in the canvas increases cross-team dependencies (runtime/infra) and implementation complexity — milestone planned with ENG-20482
